source.quote: Shanling's own product page for the M2s, read 2026-11-25 - one of four with text. THREE different rate statements appear on this one page. Main specifications: « Sampling rate : up to 384kHz / 32 bit, DSD 128 ». « Format Support » table, « DAC » row: « Supported up to 192KHz/32bit » with « windows(driver needed) » and « Mac OS ». « Format Support » table, « Hi-Res files » row: « Supporting up to DSD256,PCM up to 32bit/384KHz ». Also: « D/A converter:AK4490EQ »; « Low pass filtering : MUSES8920 »; « Rated output level: 2.2VRMS@10KOhm »; « USB / Type-C (USB 2.0) »; « External memory / Micro SD Card, supporting up to 256G ».

_la_source_est_une_annonce_ou_un_manuel_: Shanling's product pages are image-only, so every figure comes from the maker's own announcement at /article/NNNNNN or from its manual PDF, both on en.shanling.com. No number was read off an image, and nothing is sourced to store.shanling.com. See the brand file.
_ni_DoP_ni_natif_ne_sont_dits_pour_ce_mo: DoP appears on no Shanling page or manual, and « native » only in the UA dongle manuals and in EM5. Neither is stated for this model.
_le_DSD_est_donne_DEUX_FOIS_avec_deux_va: Main specifications: « DSD 128 ». Format Support, Hi-Res files row: « Supporting up to DSD256 ». One page, one product, two ceilings an octave apart, and nothing to say which supersedes which. `dsd_max` is ABSENT on this record - not unknown, absent - because the maker has published two answers and the catalogue's job is not to arbitrate. The same choice as the Audio-gd NOS 19, whose USB figure was omitted because three values existed.
_lentree_USB_est_PLUS_BASSE_que_la_lectu: « DAC / Supported up to 192KHz/32bit » for the USB mode, against 384 kHz for playback in both the other two rows. So this player reads a 384 kHz file off its card and accepts only 192 kHz from a computer - the reverse of what a reader would assume, and exactly why inputs.usb takes 192000 while `pcm_max_hz` takes 384000. The H5 states the same asymmetry in the other direction, with its USB input twice its card's ceiling.
